name: release-v2200-vs-main-paymentFailure
hypothesis: On paymentFailure, Jaeger main d22c65b9 (arm variant) and the stock 2.20.0 release (arm baseline) differ in how often claude-sonnet-5-5 pinned on the Claude Code CLI 2.1.285 at effort high reaches the cause. Exploratory release comparison, both directions possible; the two arms differ in the Jaeger build as a whole (served instructions, skills, tool schemas), not in one change. Decision rule: two-sided Fisher p < 0.05 on PASS at n=10/arm (confirmed by Roshan 2026-11-04).
